name: prompt-nav-ghostel
comment: Prompt navigation and imenu with a two-line prompt (info line, then `> ' input line): previous/next prompt and imenu jumps land on the first input character of the LAST prompt line, each prompt is visited once, and consecutive empty prompts stay separate stops. The zsh-theme variant re-appends its precmd to precmd_functions on every prompt, so ghostel's hook is never last. Run one variant per shell.

fish.setup: function fish_prompt; echo (prompt_pwd) info; echo -n '> '; end; function fish_right_prompt; end

steps.comment: from the end: live prompt, echo two, two empty prompts, echo one; each at column 2 of the `> ' line
the same prompts forward from the first one: five stops

assert.eval: (let ((l (ghostel-elate--prompt-landings t))) (and (= (length l) 5) (equal l '("2|> echo one" "2|> " "2|> " "2|> echo two" "2|> "))))

steps.comment: the live prompt and the two empty ones are three separate stops
one entry per non-empty command; jumping lands on the input start
